steps.title: Port inference for Hy-Embodied-RxBrain and bonzai from the adaptive_new reference implementations and model-directory Python: minimal execution graphs with real-checkpoint probe tests, claims via compatibility -claim, closing finding c4a76129
steps.rationale: STATUS: Bonsai half DONE (ternary Q1_0 through the serving lane, claimed at full measurement). RxBrain stages 1-2 LANDED (config contract + 1,146-tensor MoT inventory, both validated against the real checkpoint behind cmd/rxbrain-probe). Stage 3 remaining: derive the MoT decoder math from the checkpoint's own Python -- modeling_text_model_mot.py owns layer construction and the cla_share_factor pairing (attention_mot_packed.py is varlen packing only; every layer carries its own KV weights so sharing is runtime pattern), modality routing selects base vs _v branch weights per token with shared QK layernorms, SigLIP tower feeds placeholder ids 120687/120688. Stage 4: greedy vision-QA probe on demo_cases (inputs+prompts only, no reference outputs -- oracle is deterministic-decode structural assertions plus adaptive_new retained evidence: nonfixture vision + prefill + resident decode + text publication, 32-token stop-marker caveat). Claim closes the row and finding c4a76129. STAGE-3 EXECUTION ORDER (silent-failure mitigation -- preprocessing and pairing mistakes degrade output without erroring): (3a) weight loader (three bf16 shards to host) plus TEXT-ONLY MoT forward, sanity-checked on plain prompts where degeneracy is detectable, reading modeling_text_model_mot.py for CLA pairing and the unparsed rope_scaling config before any math is written; (3b) HunYuanVL vision side -- 335-tensor SigLIP-style tower plus processor semantics (anyres preprocessing, patch-grid derivation, understanding_max_pixels=524288 cap at ~494 tokens/frame, feature scatter into 120687/120688) -- comparing the tower contract against existing projector machinery layer-by-layer before writing new math; (3c) end-to-end vision-QA. Each sub-stage gates behind cmd/rxbrain-probe as its census consumer.
